## Maintenance status / 维护状态

**ClashX is no longer maintained. Please migrate to [ClashFX](https://clashfx.com/).**

Check system requirements and back up your configuration before migrating. A migration suggestion is not a claim that ClashFX fixes this issue. Existing issues are not automatically closed or transferred.
迁移前请确认系统要求并备份配置。建议迁移不代表 ClashFX 已修复此问题，现有 issue 不会自动关闭或迁移。

If you still want to record a historical ClashX problem, provide a short description below. Reports are kept for reference; no response, fix or new release is promised. You do not need to determine whether the cause is the UI or core.
如仍需记录旧版 ClashX 问题，请补充下列信息。报告保留供参考，不承诺回复、修复或新版本。无需自行判断根因属于界面还是内核。
